instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the page supports multi-language switching seamlessly with EN, HI, and MR options. Store translation dictionary in a separate modular JS object.
All 11 services specified MUST be rendered in the Key Services Grid.
Form submission MUST build a pre-filled WhatsApp link to phone 7666003113.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, and cards.
Maintain high contrast ratios: text on dark teal sections must be clean white or soft mint.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent header without backdrop-blur.
Use exact hex colors provided: Primary Teal (#0b6b7b), Accent Leaf Green (#49b646).
All interactive elements must have hover and focus states.
Ensure Devanagari script renders gracefully when switching to Hindi or Marathi.
